editorial:
If you are a One Piece fan looking for a fun little warm-up before diving into Film Z, this short special is a great way to spend a few minutes with the Straw Hat crew. You get to watch Luffy and friends goofing around on the Sunny, sharing laughs, and throwing a lively party that really captures the heart of their bond. The animation is bright and colorful, the jokes land well, and the whole thing feels like a cozy hangout with characters you already love. It is light, silly, and full of the energy that makes the series so enjoyable.

On the downside, this is a very short piece, so do not expect a full story or deep character moments. It works best as a bonus treat rather than a standalone adventure. The pacing is quick and breezy, and the final moment sets up the bigger movie nicely. If you want a quick laugh and a taste of what is coming next, you will have a good time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: The party winds down as the crew spots something strange in the ocean. A mysterious figure, Z, appears in the water, creating a tense moment that shifts the mood from fun to serious. This encounter acts as a direct setup for Film Z, teasing the bigger threat ahead. The short ends on a cliffhanger note, leaving you ready to jump straight into the main movie to see what happens next.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves One Piece and wants a quick, fun bonus before Film Z.
